comments.body: You'll want to buy all your stuff here. Its not worth the hassle of bringing it over, and everything is available at reasonable prices. This is one of the things where Switzerland is surprisingly not crazy expensive. I built a PC for myself and just recently one for my friend. If you want a top end gaming setup you can get that for about 2000 CHF (without peripherals), if you go with a 4080 super and 7800x3d. Feel free to DM me if you want more info.
comments.author: Humble_Love2736
